title: The Crown Becomes the Bow
start_prompt: The same goddess as in the reference image: same face, same tall jeweled crown with the crescent moon, same pearl and ruby jewelry and crimson silk with gold borders. Full-length vertical frame, eye level, cinematic realism, deep blue twilight. She sits cross-legged on the golden lotus above calm dark water, hands resting open, a gentle smile, the crescent moon centered on her crown.
end_prompt: The same goddess as in the reference image: same face, same tall jeweled crown with the crescent moon, same pearl and ruby jewelry and crimson silk with gold borders. Full-length vertical frame, eye level, cinematic realism, deep blue twilight. She sits on the golden lotus holding the golden crescent as a bow, drawing a rose-gold flower arrow, her crown now topped only by a small pearl, a bloom of rose light at the arrow tip.
video_prompt: The crescent moon on her crown lifts free, grows and curves into a golden bow in her hands. She draws a flower arrow and releases it. The arrow bursts into a bloom of rose-gold light that opens across the dark water. Slow eye-level push-in.
